name: Sangoma Technologies Corporation
summary:
Sangoma Technologies (SANG) reported a loss of $0.08 per share on revenue of $49.82 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended June 2026. The consensus revenue estimate was revenue of $51.50 million. Revenue fell 16.08% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

Sangoma is a trusted leader in delivering value-based Communications as a Service (CaaS) solutions for businesses of all sizes. Sangoma simplifies communications by providing businesses with the industry’s most comprehensive suite of cloud-native communications solutions, which work together seamlessly to streamline business processes.
subject: Sangoma Technologies Reported Earnings

name: AAR Corp.
summary:
AAR (AIR) reported earnings of $1.49 per share on revenue of $918.00 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. . Revenue grew 24.12% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 revenue of approximately $3.64 billion, excluding LCP. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $3.64 billion to $3.77 billion, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $3.69 billion for the year ending May 31, 2027.

AAR Corp along with its subsidiaries is engaged in providing products & services including overhaul, repair & engineering services to aviation & government & defense markets. It is also engaged in design, manufacture, & repair of transportation pallets.
subject: AAR Reported Earnings

name: Jefferies Financial Group Inc.
summary:
Jefferies Financial Group (JEF) reported earnings of $1.09 per share on revenue of $3.23 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.04 per share on revenue of $2.21 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 4.81% while revenue grew 11.11% on a year-over-year basis.

Jefferies Financial Group Inc. is a diversified financial services company engaged in investment banking and capital markets, asset management and direct investing.
subject: Jefferies Financial Group Beat Consensus Estimates

name: Vail Resorts, Inc.
summary:
Vail Resorts (MTN) reported a loss of $5.34 per share on revenue of $278.07 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended July 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $5.40 per share on revenue of $270.11 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $5.45 per share. The company beat expectations by 2.02% while revenue grew 2.50% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 net income of $158.0 million to $233.0 million, or earnings of approximately $4.43 to $6.54 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $5.84 per share for the year ending July 31, 2027.

Commenting on the Company's fiscal 2026 results, Rob Katz, Chief Executive Officer said, "This past winter was one of the most challenging winters in history across the western U.S. for the ski industry, which negatively impacted financial performance for the year. Conditions were particularly severe in the Rockies, where snowfall and snowpack were at or near historic lows and significantly below prior record-low seasons, resulting in the most difficult weather environment we have ever experienced. With that backdrop, this past year demonstrated the resilience of our business model and encouraging signs for the future. Our advanced commitment model and cost discipline provided considerable stability, and our investments in talent, technology and our resorts drove record guest satisfaction scores and strong employee engagement, which are critical measures of our success.

Vail Resorts Inc, through its subsidiaries, is a mountain resort operator. The Company' operations are grouped into three business segments: Mountain, Lodging and Real Estate.
subject: Vail Resorts Beat Expectations
